description: Exchange an authorization code and PKCE verifier, or a refresh token, for a short-lived agent access token and a new refresh token. Refresh tokens rotate: each works once, and reusing one revokes the whole chain. With grant_type urn:workos:agent-auth:grant-type:claim and your claim_token (auth.md), poll until the owner approves: errors are authorization_pending, slow_down, expired_token and access_denied; success hands over a named agent key once (no refresh token, it does not expire until revoked).
name: auth_oauthToken
